terms.body: This installs itelxOS 1.2, a 64-bit operating system of the IFelx family with its own kernel, the ITFS filesystem, the itelx terminal and the XVC language. Its kernel is licensed under the itelx Kernel License 1.0 (use and share unchanged) and its userspace under the Mozilla Public License 2.0. By continuing you accept all listed terms and conditions.

finish.title: Installation Complete
finish.message: itelxOS is installed. Remove the installation media, then restart the computer: it starts straight into the itelx terminal.
